question: Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is located in Meghalaya.**
 
• The representative parts of natural and cultural landscapes extending over large areas of terrestrial or coastal/ marine ecosystems or a combination of both designated by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation (UNESCO) is called a Biosphere Reserve.
